name: Synth Bass
description: Dry, punchy saw bass reconstructed from a mobile recording. Fast bright attack settles into a darker harmonic body; every MIDI note retriggers. Tone scales filter brightness, Decay sets the filter sweep duration, and Drive adds compensated saturation. Suggested MIDI notes 33-53 (A1-F3). Velocity-sensitive, centered Stereo Output; route through the mixer to Master. No recorded audio, noise, room reverb, or legato mode.
